sources.entry: LocalScribe - Open-source local transcription and subtitle editor for microphones, media files, and Mac audio. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/maddylaneeee/ShengJi) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: LocalScribe is a free, open-source native macOS app for Apple silicon that transcribes microphone input, media files, and Mac audio into editable text and subtitles entirely on the device.
summary.what_it_does: LocalScribe records or imports speech from a microphone, media files, or Mac system audio and converts it to text using local engines (Apple Speech, whisper.cpp with Metal, SenseVoice, or NVIDIA Parakeet). It offers floating live captions on macOS 26, an editable transcript view with search, replace, and trimming, and import of SRT, WebVTT, TXT, Markdown, and JSON. Transcripts can be translated with Apple Translation by default or optional local NLLB, then exported as TXT, Markdown, JSON, PDF, SRT, or WebVTT. An optional on-device Gemma 4 model can proofread or summarize transcripts, and custom AI services (LM Studio, OpenAI, DeepSeek) can be configured as an alternative, with cloud options marked as preview. It also includes long-task recovery journals, pause/resume, and a command-line interface.
use_cases: transcribe meeting or lecture recordings locally
generate SRT or WebVTT subtitles for video files
create live captions from Mac audio
edit and clean up speech-to-text output
proofread or summarize a transcript with on-device AI
how_to_run: Download the latest DMG from the GitHub Releases page and drag LocalScribe to Applications
If macOS blocks the app, allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Security (Open Anyway)
Run tests: xcodebuild -project LocalScribe.xcodeproj -scheme LocalScribe -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' test
CLI example: LocalScribe.app/Contents/MacOS/LocalScribe --cli transcribe input.mp4 --engine whisper --language en_US --format srt --output output.srt
notable: Runs recognition and on-device Gemma 4 enhancement locally with no account required
Choice of multiple offline engines: Apple Speech, Whisper, SenseVoice, Parakeet
Append-only session journals and recovery for long recordings
Optional saving of original microphone audio as M4A with playback and export
Command-line interface for models, transcription, export, and translation
caveats: Requires Apple silicon and macOS 15.5 or later; Apple SpeechAnalyzer and live captions need macOS 26, and SenseVoice and Parakeet are file-only
Current build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple, so Gematekeeper warnings must be overridden manually
Optional NLLB model is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0; OpenAI and DeepSeek connectors are preview features pending production-key validation
